subject: Read PLAN.md and VPS_TRAINING_PROMPT.md
description: Read both planning docs to understand milestones, guardrails, and acceptance criteria.

subject: uv sync --all-groups
description: Install all dependency groups (torch, numpy, pytest, ruff, modal).

subject: Run test gate: uv run pytest -q
description: Must pass (11 tests, <120s) before any Modal spend. Do NOT proceed if tests fail.

subject: Start Phase 1 Modal training (seed 7 + seed 13)
description: Run modal_app.py::train_and_evaluate for seed 7 and seed 13.

subject: Pull results and commit
description: modal volume get results_seed7.json to results/sample_results.json, then commit.

subject: Push commits to remote (git push origin main)
description: Push the Phase 1 results commit to origin/main.

subject: Run M3 sweep on Modal
description: uv run modal run modal_app.py::sweep — 9 cells (seed×overlap). Pull per-cell JSON, build results/

subject: Phase 2 M6: prepare_data + train (pretrain chat LM)
description: modal run train_chat_lm_modal.py::prepare_data then ::train. Acceptance: final train loss <=1.9, coh
